title: Smoky Slovakian Myeongnan Roe Poke
description: A unique and quick-fix Slovakian dish featuring smoky myeongnan roe, sashimi-cut and served as a glassy-jelly poke, this recipe is fodmap-friendly and perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil, rice vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the smoky dressing.
In a separate bowl, mix together myeongnan roe, toasted sesame seeds, and chopped green onions.
Pour the smoky dressing over the myeongnan roe mixture and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the myeongnan roe mixture.
Serve the smoky myeongnan roe poke chilled, garnished with additional toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.
Use a glassy-jelly mold to shape the poke into a unique and visually appealing dish.
